title: RFB · Pipeline health & tracing
description: Health, tracing, volume and data quality of the RFB lakehouse pipeline (source: audit schema, Pushgateway metrics, node/Spark exporters).

list.name: run_id
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT run_id FROM audit.pipeline_run WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100
list.definition: SELECT run_id FROM audit.pipeline_run WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100

target.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, coalesce(finished_at, now()) AS timeend, 'rfb ' || coalesce(ref_month::text, '') || ' ' || status AS text, status AS tags FROM audit.pipeline_run WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

targets.rawSql: SELECT status FROM audit.pipeline_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id'
SELECT ref_month::text FROM audit.pipeline_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id'
SELECT extract(epoch FROM coalesce(finished_at, now()) - started_at) FROM audit.pipeline_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id'
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (task_id) status FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY task_id, attempt DESC) t WHERE status = 'FAILED'
SELECT coalesce(sum(rows_out), 0) FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND layer IN ('bronze','silver','gold')
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'BLOCK') AS block, count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'WARN') AS warn FROM audit.dq_event WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND status = 'FAIL'
SELECT coalesce(sum(rows_rejected), 0) FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id'

panels.title: Trace of the run
panels.description: Root span = DAG run; children = task attempts; grandchildren = timed steps logged by the scripts (fields.seconds). Built from audit.v_trace_spans.

targets.rawSql: SELECT "traceID", "spanID", "parentSpanID", "operationName", "serviceName", "startTime", duration FROM audit.v_trace_spans WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY "startTime"

SELECT task_id || CASE WHEN attempt > 1 THEN ' #' || attempt ELSE '' END AS task, round(coalesce(duration_s, extract(epoch FROM now() - started_at))) AS seconds FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY started_at

SELECT task_id, layer, entity, attempt, status, started_at, round(duration_s) AS duration_s, rows_in, rows_out, rows_rejected, bytes_out, warn_count, block_count, airflow_task_id, spark_app_id, error_class, left(error_message, 200) AS error FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY started_at
SELECT started_at AS time, task_id AS metric, duration_s AS value FROM audit.task_run WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' AND duration_s IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1
SELECT started_at AS time, task_id AS metric, rows_out AS value FROM audit.task_run WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' AND rows_out IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1
SELECT started_at AS time, task_id AS metric, rows_out / nullif(duration_s, 0) AS value FROM audit.task_run WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' AND rows_out > 0 AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Delta tables — volume and file health
Latest state of every Delta table
panels.description: Small files (avg < 32 MiB with many files) ask for OPTIMIZE; rows_written = last operation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (table_name) table_name, layer, delta_version, operation, rows_total, size_bytes, num_files, round(size_bytes / nullif(num_files, 0) / 1048576.0, 1) AS avg_file_mib, rows_written, captured_at FROM audit.delta_table_stats WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' ORDER BY table_name, captured_at DESC

SELECT table_name, rows_total FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (table_name) table_name, layer, delta_version, operation, rows_total, size_bytes, num_files, round(size_bytes / nullif(num_files, 0) / 1048576.0, 1) AS avg_file_mib, rows_written, captured_at FROM audit.delta_table_stats WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' ORDER BY table_name, captured_at DESC) t ORDER BY rows_total DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT table_name, size_bytes FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (table_name) table_name, layer, delta_version, operation, rows_total, size_bytes, num_files, round(size_bytes / nullif(num_files, 0) / 1048576.0, 1) AS avg_file_mib, rows_written, captured_at FROM audit.delta_table_stats WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' ORDER BY table_name, captured_at DESC) t ORDER BY size_bytes DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT captured_at AS time, table_name AS metric, rows_total AS value FROM audit.delta_table_stats WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' AND rows_total IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(captured_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT captured_at AS time, table_name || ' ' || operation AS metric, rows_written AS value FROM audit.delta_table_stats WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' AND rows_written IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(captured_at) ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at, task_id, check_name, severity, status, observed, threshold, message FROM audit.dq_event WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY (status = 'FAIL') DESC, created_at

panels.title: Reconciliation by entity (rows across layers)
panels.description: extracted == bronze_out + quarantined is a BLOCK check (bronze.rows_match_source).

targets.rawSql: SELECT entity, max(rows_out) FILTER (WHERE layer = 'extract') AS extracted, max(rows_in) FILTER (WHERE layer = 'bronze') AS bronze_in, max(rows_out) FILTER (WHERE layer = 'bronze') AS bronze_out, max(rows_in) FILTER (WHERE layer = 'silver') AS silver_in, sum(rows_rejected) AS quarantined FROM audit.task_run WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND entity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entity ORDER BY entity

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), check_name AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM audit.dq_event WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' AND status = 'FAIL' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (entity, reason) created_at, entity, file_name, reason, rows, left(sample, 300) AS sample FROM audit.quarantine_summary WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' ORDER BY entity, reason, created_at DESC

panels.title: Preflight health checks of the run

targets.rawSql: SELECT component, status, latency_ms, detail::text AS detail FROM audit.health_check WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY component
SELECT checked_at AS time, component AS metric, latency_ms AS value FROM audit.health_check WHERE pipeline = 'rfb' AND $__timeFilter(checked_at) ORDER BY 1
